businessPlan: AFK recertification for the already-scoped TASK-003 outcome: projects that explicitly enable semanticNavigation for Serena in external mode should receive role-specific prompt guidance only for roles enabled in config. Brain guidance must support orientation, architecture understanding, and self-contained delegation with concrete file/symbol references; Coder guidance must require semantic lookup plus exact built-in file inspection and runnable validation; Reviewer guidance must use semantic navigation for coverage only, never as behavior proof. Disabled/default configs and roles set to off must keep existing prompts behavior-compatible.
technicalPlan: Use the existing prompt/runtime config seam. The implementation surface is extensions/workflow/prompts.ts for pure role-specific guidance helpers, extensions/workflow/runtime/config.ts for getAgentPreset composition using config.semanticNavigation, scripts/task-003-serena-prompt-guidance-smokes.ts for behavior/regression coverage, and docs/workflow-config-v2.md for the user-facing role/evidence boundary. For this AFK run, coder should inspect the current implementation and make no changes if it already satisfies the matrix; if a gap is found, patch only the listed files with minimal TDD-style smoke coverage. Preserve DEFAULT_CONFIG prompt constants, default tool/profile behavior, delegate/reviewer/finalization evidence semantics, and avoid hard-coding Serena MCP tool names in prompt-gating runtime logic.
parallelAssessment: serial. TASK-003 has brain:parallel=auto, but the code shape is a tightly coupled prompt/runtime/test/doc contract. Safe independent ownership boundaries are not available because changing guidance text, getAgentPreset composition, and smoke assertions must stay synchronized. No workflow room is needed for implementation or review.
contractBlockPlan: Single AFK recertification phase using phaseA: (1) verify role-specific guidance text/helpers in extensions/workflow/prompts.ts; (2) verify getAgentPreset appends guidance through config.semanticNavigation in extensions/workflow/runtime/config.ts; (3) verify smoke coverage in scripts/task-003-serena-prompt-guidance-smokes.ts for enabled Brain/Coder/Reviewer text, disabled/default config, role-off config, stable repeated calls, and non-Serena prompt compatibility; (4) verify docs/workflow-config-v2.md states prompt guidance is role-gated and Serena output is not validation evidence. Required checks: npx tsx --conditions import scripts/task-003-serena-prompt-guidance-smokes.ts; npx tsx --conditions import scripts/task-001-serena-semantic-navigation-config-smokes.ts; npx tsx --conditions import scripts/task-002-serena-tool-profiles-smokes.ts; git diff --check -- extensions/workflow/prompts.ts extensions/workflow/runtime/config.ts docs/workflow-config-v2.md scripts/task-003-serena-prompt-guidance-smokes.ts.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.criterion: Brain guidance emphasizes orientation, architecture understanding, and concrete file/symbol refs before delegation.
acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Brain may delegate vague work or miss architecture context, weakening the Brain-to-Coder contract and increasing implementation guesswork.

requiredEvidence.description: TASK-003 smoke asserts enabled Brain effective guidance contains orientation, architecture understanding, concrete file/symbol/reference findings, and self-contained delegation boundaries.
Diff/inspection shows Brain guidance is role-specific and added through semanticNavigation-gated prompt composition.

blockingConditions: Brain guidance is shared/generic instead of role-specific.
Brain guidance omits architecture understanding, concrete file/symbol references, or self-contained delegation boundaries.
Brain guidance appears when semanticNavigation is disabled, unsupported, or role access is off.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.criterion: Coder guidance requires exact built-in file inspection before final edits and validation commands after semantic edits.
acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Coder could rely on semantic edits without reading exact source or running validation, causing unsafe edits and false completion evidence.

requiredEvidence.description: TASK-003 smoke asserts enabled Coder effective guidance requires exact built-in file/read inspection before final edits and validation commands after semantic edits.
Diff/inspection shows Coder guidance preserves validation/evidence requirements and says Serena findings are not validation proof.

blockingConditions: Coder guidance implies Serena output can replace built-in file reads.
Coder guidance omits validation commands after semantic edits.
Coder guidance weakens existing coder evidence or validation gates.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.criterion: Reviewer guidance treats Serena output as review coverage, not behavioral evidence.
acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.businessRiskIfWrong: Reviewer could approve based on semantic inspection alone, weakening behavioral evidence and finalization reliability.

requiredEvidence.description: TASK-003 smoke asserts enabled Reviewer guidance covers changed symbols/references/diagnostics as review coverage/supporting context and not behavioral/runtime validation evidence.

blockingConditions: Reviewer guidance states or implies semantic navigation proves behavior.
Reviewer guidance omits runtime/behavior evidence boundaries.
Reviewer guidance encourages reviewer edit/refactor tools.

acceptanceEvidenceMatrix.criterion: Serena guidance is absent when semanticNavigation is disabled or role is not enabled.
